x-values.summary: device counts by vendor and type
x-values.devices: name, vendor, OS, model, type, location, tags
x-values.interfaces: interfaces of a device or the network
x-values.cloud_accounts: cloud accounts and whether each was collected
x-values.cloud_coverage: per cloud setup, how much was collected and what was not
x-values.endpoints: endpoints rolled up by profile: collected, not collected
x-values.lifecycle: OS support dates by vendor and OS
x-values.cloud_gateways: cloud gateways, VPN connections and their state
x-values.ip_owner: the interface that owns an IP
x-values.routes: route next hops of a device and VRF
x-values.bgp_families: the BGP address families a network runs, read from config: device counts by family and OS; name = a family lists its devices
x-values.security_rules_experimental: rule and object counts of Forward's experimental security rules model

ips.description: kind ip_owner, required: the IPv4 addresses whose owning interface to find

compare_to_snapshot_id.description: kind devices: another snapshot to compare with; lists the devices added and removed since it, with counts by vendor, type and name prefix

vendor.description: kinds devices and security_rules_experimental: only this vendor (Forward's vendor name, case-insensitive, such as FORTINET or CISCO)
